entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I hope you can help me. I need to return a helmet I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is VF88192-C. It's just... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really, really need the money back from this.
Okay, Sarah, thank you. I see your order for the Trail Helmet right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's nothing like that. It's a beautiful helmet. It's just... the color. It looked different on the website, and it just doesn't feel right. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. I was so excited, but now I'm just so disappointed.

I understand. Getting the color just right is important, and we want you to be completely happy with your gear. Your safety is our priority, and that starts with feeling confident in what you're wearing. Let me just check the return policy for you.
Please... I really hope you can. Things are a bit tight right now.

Of course. One moment... Okay, I see you received the item 16 days ago. According to our policy, you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... oh, thank you so much, David! That is such a huge relief. I was so worried.

You're very welcome, Sarah. I'm happy I could help. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've made my day!
Great to hear. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
